statement: A native affine S3 projection prototype uses one joint affine solve and a linear Artin-Schreier section for even and odd word fields. Producer unit tests match complete unordered subspace-pair enumeration for every nonzero target abscissa in degrees 2 through 8, with two basis forms and three constants. Zero-target, out-of-field, dependent-basis and residual-cap cases are explicit. This is an abscissa-pair component without signed-point or IC integration and has no performance measurement.
